subtitle: Lesson 28 · Security Policy, Governance & Defense in Depth

steps.label: Badge access
steps.sub: restricts entry, logs who went in, where, and when

steps.label: Mantraps
steps.sub: interlocking doors verify one person at a time — no tailgating

steps.label: Security cameras
steps.sub: deterrent and evidence around entrances and server rooms

steps.label: Visitor logs
steps.sub: every non-employee recorded — name, time, who they're visiting

steps.label: HVAC/cooling
steps.sub: keeps servers in a safe temperature and humidity range

steps.label: Fire suppression
steps.sub: specialized agents, not water, to protect electronics

steps.label: UPS / backup power
steps.sub: bridges an outage until shutdown or a generator takes over

code:
Attacker walks into the server room,
physically removes a drive:

  CONFIDENTIALITY  — data on it is now exposed
  AVAILABILITY     — the system it powered is now down

No firewall rule prevents either outcome.
caption: Physical security is the layer underneath every other layer.
